name: Kujou Shiori
source:
A daughter of the Kujou House. The house serves directly to the Mikado House and may be referred to as its personal guards. It oversees the genealogy of all noble houses, identifies possible threats, and intervenes when necessary. Shiori has a younger brother who is the heir of their house.

She took part in the Fencing Kagura ceremony, [spoiler]but [url=https://vndb.org/c34796]Sakagami Habaki[/url]'s dirty trick caused her to lose her will to fight[/spoiler]. She went to the Eastern Expedition "for domestic training". [spoiler]In the first battle of the conquest, she had lost her hands. They were replaced by prostheses, created by [url=https://vndb.org/c34804]Mikado Ryuumei[/url] with the use of puppet art.[/spoiler]

Although Kujou House has its own battle techniques, the ones of Shiori are not pure. She employs not only the mastery of the house teaching but also her distortion: she can make her possibilities appear and switch between them at will. It makes her a particularly dangerous opponent because defeating her necessitates defeating all of her possibilities at the same time. She could be an heir of the Kujou House, but she has relinquished the right to her little brother. Her purpose for doing so is to become a bride. [spoiler]She aspires to be the greatest version of herself and to excel in all areas. For that reason, she has been constantly perfecting herself. The one she lost in exchange is the strong grasp on herself. Still retaining her core, Shiori has become a vague person, who has become one who is reflected in an opponent's eyes. And she needs a husband who will reflect her in his sword as her finest self in order to become so and grip that self firmly. Shiori is looking for just this kind of reflection.[/spoiler]

[spoiler][i][url=https://vndb.org/c34798]Mibu Soujirou[/url] was the one who gave her the reflection.[/i][/spoiler]
